forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {集|あつ}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to collect, to gather (things or people)
definitions.explanation: To bring things or people together in one place. This is the transitive form—someone actively collects or gathers something.
To draw or attract something abstract like attention or interest toward oneself or something.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pair: ⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (intransitive, to gather). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{集|あつ}める (collect X).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ can indicate ongoing action or resulting state. {集|あつ}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is collecting' (ongoing) or 'has collected' (resulting state with accumulated items).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{集|あつ}める (collect stamps)
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{集|あつ}める (gather information)
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{集|あつ}める (attract attention)
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{集|あつ}める (gain popularity)
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{集|あつ}める (collect materials/documents)

REGISTER: Neutral. Used in both casual and formal contexts.
